description: Source code implementing in-flight I/O operations for disk cache, including classes BackgroundIO and InFlightIO with methods for managing asynchronous I/O tasks.

classes.name: BackgroundIO
classes.description: Represents an in-flight background I/O operation with methods to handle signaling, cancellation, and callback invocation.

classes.name: InFlightIO
classes.description: Manages multiple BackgroundIO objects, handling their lifecycle, completion, and callback invocation.

methods.name: BackgroundIO::OnIOSignalled
methods.description: Called when I/O operation is signaled as complete; invokes callback on the controller.

methods.name: InFlightIO::NotifyController
methods.description: Notifies the controller that I/O has completed.

methods.name: InFlightIO::WaitForPendingIO
methods.description: Blocks until all pending I/O operations complete.

methods.name: InFlightIO::DropPendingIO
methods.description: Cancels and removes all pending I/O operations.

methods.name: InFlightIO::OnIOComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of an I/O operation, posting signaling task.

methods.name: InFlightIO::InvokeCallback
methods.description: Waits for I/O completion, optionally cancels, and invokes the callback.

methods.name: InFlightIO::OnOperationPosted
methods.description: Adds a new operation to the list of in-flight operations.
